name: Shen
notes: Twilight Assault (Q) and Shadow Dash (E) are both off cooldown at t=0 and are cast immediately; Ki Barrier (P), Spirit's Refuge (W) and Stand United (R) are purely defensive/utility and are never cast since they deal no damage.

The recalled Spirit Blade is assumed to pass through/overlap the stationary target on every Twilight Assault cast (the sources leave this geometry open for a stationary 1v1), so every Q grants the enhanced empowered-attack tier and its 50% bonus attack speed for the 8 s window.

Twilight Assault is recast every time it comes off cooldown; a fresh cast resets the empowered-attack counter to 3 and refreshes the 8 s window rather than stacking, since the sources describe only one buff instance.

The empowered attack's flat on-hit portion is identical for the base and enhanced tiers (both read the same by-level array); only the percent-of-target-max-health term (and its AP scaling) differs between tiers, and it is applied against the target's current maximum health at the moment of the hit.

Shadow Dash's brief travel before its post-effect cooldown starts is not modeled: its damage lands and its cooldown starts on cast, since dash duration depends on Shen's own move speed (item-build dependent) and is negligible over an 8-15 s fight.
Energy is not modeled: the sources do not give Shen's base energy pool or regeneration, so it cannot be shown to bind inside a 15 s fight at level 16; costs are ignored.
